default_behavior_unchanged.detail: Repository JobsSettings defaults the budget map to empty. Default execution keeps ordinary per-call behavior; original positive job_status waits intentionally gain additive policy observability while zero-wait and listing payloads retain their prior shape.

prefix_configuration_correct.detail: Client prefixes must be nonblank, budgets validate in 1..3600 seconds, and the longest matching prefix wins deterministically.

base_turn_correlation_reliable_and_conse.detail: Only request IDs with a nonempty base and call suffix publish current_turn; missing/malformed IDs publish None. Context resets are covered on success, error, sequential, concurrent, and authenticated HTTP paths.

sequential_accounting_charges_actual_wal.detail: Early release charges measured monotonic wall time, sequential waits accumulate, productive gaps are free, and less than one second remaining becomes nonblocking.

overlapping_waits_charge_union_wall_time.detail: Unit and real-job concurrency coverage verify two/five overlapping waits, overlapping waves, and different jobs in one turn share the original active-window deadline and charge the wall-time union once.

exceptions_can_strand_active_lease.detail: Leases release in finally paths; exception/cancellation-equivalent tests and integration coverage leave active_count consistent.

memory_bounded.detail: The process-local tracker is bounded to 4096 total turn records by default; inactive records are LRU-evictable.

active_records_protected_from_eviction.detail: Active records are never evicted. If capacity is entirely active, a new turn uses explicit capacity_untracked fail-open behavior.

capacity_fallback_preserves_ordinary_beh.detail: capacity_untracked preserves the ordinary bounded wait and does not mutate tracked turns.

exhaustion_model_visible.detail: Positive-wait output exposes policy/budget/remaining/exhaustion fields; a still-running exhausted job explicitly states that later positive waits in the turn will be nonblocking.

logs_stats_reconstruct_policy_decisions.detail: job_status_timing logs requested/bounded/effective/actual waits plus policy and tracker state; blocking_window_closed records cumulative spent/remaining values; logstats aggregates policy counts, per-turn union wall, utilization buckets, and p50/p90/p95/max.

durable_jobs_survive_exhaustion_and_relo.detail: Real-job tests keep exhausted jobs observable/running until explicit stop, and replacing the process-local tracker resets only ephemeral budget state while the durable job remains observable and stoppable.

measured_overhead.detail: Three independent 100000-iteration Pi runs measured median run-level p95 0.006445 ms and p99 0.007259 ms, passing p95 <1 ms and p99 <2 ms.

ready_for_phase3_offline_replay.detail: Phase-2 implementation, integration, concurrency, telemetry, and overhead evidence are green. Phase 3 has not started and no production deployment or budget enablement occurred.

ai_readability.assessment: AI-readability is advisory rather than blocking. Module-size and architecture checks have zero errors; final validation does not introduce a behavioral refactor solely to silence advisory warnings.

validation.tracker_test_isolation: Guard integration/concurrency fixtures replace the process-local tracker with per-test instances via monkeypatch and clean durable job fixtures; focused and full suites pass without observed cross-test state leakage.
